outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE LIKELY FROM PARTS OF NORTH TEXAS AND OKLAHOMA NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE MISSOURI AND MID-MISSISSIPPI VALLEYS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN CONCERN BY LATE IN THE DAY...CONCENTRATED ACROSS OKLAHOMA AND NORTH TEXAS...WITH A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO POSSIBLE AS WELL. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL OR WIND IS ALSO POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY FROM THE OHIO VALLEY INTO THE MID ATLANTIC.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN UPPER LOW WILL SWING NEWD ACROSS ND DURING THE DAY...DETACHING FROM THE LARGER-SCALE UPPER TROUGH WHICH WILL EXTEND SWD ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS. BY LATE AFTERNOON...THE PRIMARY SPEED MAX ALOFT WILL BE LOCATED OVER ERN NEB INTO NRN KS...AND WILL CONTINUE NEWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY OVERNIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL TRANSLATE NEWD ACROSS IA DURING THE DAY AS A WARM FRONT MIXES NWD ACROSS MO AND INTO CNTRL IL AND EXTENDS SEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY. A VERY MOIST AIR MASS WILL EXIST ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...SUPPORTING SCATTERED STORMS DURING THE DAY FROM IA INTO THE OH VALLEY. OTHER STORMS WILL ALSO FORM ACROSS VA AND NC WITH WARM ADVECTION FROM THE WEST AND UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF A WEAK DISTURBANCE NOW PRODUCING THUNDERSTORMS OVER KY TUE EVENING. TO THE S...30-40 KT MIDLEVEL FLOW ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER TROUGH WILL SPREAD INTO OK AND FAR NRN TX...WITH A VERY WEAK SFC FRONT FROM WRN MO SWWD ACROSS CNTRL OK AND INTO NWRN TX BY LATE AFTERNOON. S OF THE BOUNDARY...A VERY MOIST AIR MASS IS LIKELY TO EXIST...THOUGH THE EFFECTS OF TUE NIGHT STORMS OVER TX MAY PLAY A PIVOTAL ROLE IN DESTABILIZATION DURING THE DAY ACROSS OK AND TX. NONETHELESS...STRONG INSTABILITY

sections.title: ERN KS AND MO EARLY IN THE DAY
sections.text: SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY CONTINUE TO DEVELOP NWD INTO ERN KS/WRN MO THIS EVENING...AND CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE FORECAST TO ENVELOP MUCH OF NERN KS AND NWRN MO BY WED MORNING WITH A THREAT OF LARGE HAIL. FURTHER DEVELOPMENT OF SAID CLUSTER DURING THE LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON HOURS COULD ALSO RESULT IN A WIND THREAT ACROSS MO SHOULD AN MCS DEVELOP.

sections.title: OK INTO NRN TX LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: HEATING WILL OCCUR ACROSS THE REGION AS THE FRONT SLOWLY MOVES SWD AND SLOWS FROM SWRN MO ACROSS CNTRL OK. WHILE A VERY MOIST AIR MASS WITH DEWPOINTS OVER 70 F CURRENTLY EXISTS OVER OK...50S F DEWPOINTS ARE UPSTREAM NEAR THE RED RIVER AND INTO NRN TX IN ASSOCIATION WITH A LARGE STORM COMPLEX. THIS COMPLEX...ROUGHLY THE SIZE OF LOUISIANA...WAS NOT AT ALL INITIALIZED BY THE 00Z NAM WHICH MAINTAINS 70S F DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE ENTIRE AREA. THEREFORE...MUCH UNCERTAINTY EXISTS AT THIS TIME REGARDING PRECISELY HOW MUCH INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP S OF THE BOUNDARY. REGARDLESS...MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP...WHETHER IT IS 2500 OR 4000 J/KG MUCAPE...AND HODOGRAPH AUGMENTATION IN THE LOW-LEVELS IS ALSO POSSIBLE ALONG THE SAGGING BOUNDARY. CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP NEAR 00Z THE 12TH ALONG THE LENGTH OF THE BOUNDARY...PERHAPS BEGINNING AS SUPERCELLS. HODOGRAPHS ARE RELATIVELY SMALL IN SIZE...BUT MAY FAVOR SLOW EWD-MOVING SUPERCELLS PRIOR TO UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR LIKELY ACROSS THE ENH AREA. IN ADDITION...A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY INITIAL STORMS ON THE FRONT WHERE NLY SFC WINDS ENHA

sections.title: IA INTO IL DURING THE AFTERNOON
sections.text: SHEAR PROFILES ARE FORECAST TO BE LOCALLY ENHANCED NEAR SFC LOW AS IT MOVES ACROSS IA. SOME HEATING IS EXPECTED WITH MID 60S F DEWPOINTS...AND WIND PROFILES WILL BE VEERING WITH HEIGHT. THIS MAY RESULT IN A CORRIDOR OF SUPERCELL POTENTIAL...HOWEVER...MODELS ALSO FORECAST SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTION ACROSS ERN KS INTO NWRN MO TUE NIGHT INTO WED MORNING...AND THIS MAY AFFECT THE SFC LOW TRACK AS WELL AS INSTABILITY. THE NAM SHOWS THE LOW OVER IA WITH AND THE GFS OVER NRN MO BY 00Z THE 12TH. CONDITIONALLY...A FEW SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE WITH ATTENDANT HAIL AND PERHAPS TORNADO THREAT...BUT UNCERTAINTY IS TOO HIGH AT THIS TIME FOR GREATER SEVERE PROBABILITIES. ..JEWELL.. 05/11/2016

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE LIKELY FROM PARTS OF NORTH TEXAS AND OKLAHOMA NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE MISSOURI AND MID-MISSISSIPPI VALLEYS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN CONCERN. A FEW SEVERE STORMS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER PARTS OF NORTH CAROLINA.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER NC
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS STRETCHING FROM THE SOUTHERN/CENTRAL PLAINS...INTO THE MID/UPPER MS VALLEY...EASTWARD TO THE MID ATLANTIC...

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: ...SRN IL...FAR SW IND...FAR SW KY... LATEST SURFACE OBSERVATIONS REVEAL A REMNANT BOUNDARY -- INDICATED BY A SUBTLE VEERING OF THE SURFACE WINDS -- ACROSS SRN IL. RECENT RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND JUST S OF THIS BOUNDARY...SUGGESTING THE ONGOING SVR CLUSTER ACROSS SW IL WILL FORWARD-PROPAGATE EWD/ESEWD ALONG THIS BOUNDARY. SVR HAIL AND WIND ARE EXPECTED AS THIS OCCURS...RESULTING IN AN ISOLATED AREA OF HIGHER SVR COVERAGE DOWNSTREAM. AS SUCH...INTRODUCED A SMALL AREA ENHANCED AREA ACROSS SRN IL..FAR SW IND...AND FAR SW KY. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION CAN BE FOUND IN MCD 603.

sections.title: TX
sections.text: CU HAS INCREASED NEAR THE TRIPLE-POINT E OF LBB WITH CONVECTIVE INITIATION POSSIBLE SOON. AIRMASS HERE SUPPORTS A SVR THREAT AND THE OUTLOOK LINES WERE ADJUSTED WWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS THREAT. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE IN MCD 604.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: DESPITE EARLY-DAY CONVECTION...RE-DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED NEAR THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY CURRENTLY MOVING SWWD ACROSS E-CNTRL MO. ENVIRONMENT HERE REMAINS SUPPORTIVE OF SVR HAIL AND WIND. ISOLATED SVR ALSO REMAINS POSSIBLE ACROSS NC. ..MOSIER.. 05/11/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT WED MAY 11 2016/

sections.title: MID MS INTO OH VALLEYS
sections.text: A REMNANT MCS IS OVER MO LATE THIS MORNING. A MOIST AND VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THIS COMPLEX WILL ADVECT NORTHWARD AND FUEL THE REDEVELOPMENT OF STORMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. MODELS DIFFER CONSIDERABLY ON THE EVOLUTION OF THIS ACTIVITY...BUT IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT STORMS WILL INTENSIFY OVER PARTS OF MO AND SPREAD EASTWARD INTO SOUTHERN IL/IND AND WESTERN/CENTRAL KY. WIND FIELDS ARE ONLY MODERATELY STRONG...BUT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL OR OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: NC
sections.text: MODERATE CAPE VALUES WILL BE PRESENT THIS AFTERNOON FROM KY/TN INTO PARTS OF VA/NC. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ALONG THIS CORRIDOR AND TRACK SLOWLY EASTWARD. AS CLOUD COVER ERODES ACROSS NC...IT APPEARS THERE WILL BE SUFFICIENT OVERLAP OF DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR AND CAPE TO POSE A RISK THAT A FEW OF THE STORMS WILL PRODUCE HAIL AND GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS. THEREFORE HAVE ADDED A SLIGHT RISK AREA FOR THIS REGION.

sections.title: OK/TX
sections.text: THE OVERNIGHT MCS THAT AFFECTED TX HAS EFFECTIVELY STABILIZED MUCH OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS...WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS NOW ONLY IN THE LOW/MID 60S. NEVERTHELESS...IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM LATE THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SURFACE DRYLINE OVER PARTS OF WEST TX INTO SOUTHERN OK...AND ALONG THE SURFACE COLD FRONT SAGGING SOUTHWARD INTO THE REGION. VERTICAL SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAK. HOWEVER...THOSE STORMS THAT FORM MAY POSE A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS FOR SEVERAL HOURS THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NERN NM/TX PANHANDLE
sections.text: MOST MODEL SOLUTIONS CONTINUE TO INDICATE THAT A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON OVER NORTHEAST NM AND TRACK EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE TX PANHANDLE THIS EVENING. MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY ARE QUITE LIMITED IN THIS AREA...BUT SUFFICIENT SHEAR MAY RESULT IN ENOUGH ORGANIZATION FOR SOME RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL INCREASE ACROSS NERN MO INTO CNTRL IL THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OVERNIGHT MCS THAT EVOLVED OVER THE CNTRL PLAINS HAS PROGRESSED INTO THE MID MS VALLEY WITH LARGER PRECIP SHIELD SLOWLY DISSIPATING. HOWEVER...LONE SEVERE TSTM HAS EVOLVED ALONG LEADING EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY OVER NERN MO AND IS LIKELY PRODUCING LARGE HAIL. THERE IS SOME CONCERN THIS CONVECTION MAY NOT DIE OFF BUT RATHER SLOWLY INCREASE IN AREAL COVERAGE AS IT PROPAGATES EWD INTO IL. 16Z SFC OBS SUGGEST A WELL-DEFINED NW-SE ORIENTED BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM NEAR STL...SEWD INTO SRN IL. WARM ADVECTION ATOP THIS NWD-ADVANCING BOUNDARY COULD ENCOURAGE ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...ESPECIALLY GIVEN THAT A WEAK SWLY LLJ IS FORECAST TO IMPINGE ON THIS BOUNDARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS MAY OCCUR WITH THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS THIS REGION. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THE CAROLINAS REMAINS NEBULOUS THIS AFTERNOON...AS AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE ERN GREAT LAKES CONTINUES TO DEAMPLIFY AND MOVE AWAY FROM THE MCD REGION. A MCV FROM CONVECTION YESTERDAY ACROSS KY IS APPROACHING THE DC METRO AREA AS OF 18Z...AND IT SHOULD CONTINUE NEWD AWAY FROM THE CAROLINAS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. AT THE SFC...AN ILL-DEFINED/REMNANT FRONT REMAINS DRAPED FROM W-E ACROSS NRN NC INTO SERN VA PER RECENT SFC OBSERVATIONS. CONVECTION ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN TN EARLIER THIS MORNING HAS WEAKENED...BUT ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT HAS RECENTLY OCCURRED ACROSS SERN TN AND THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NRN GA AND WRN NC/SC. LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES THE CU FIELD ACROSS PARTS OF NC/SC TO THE S OF THE FRONTAL BOUNDARY IS BEGINNING TO SHOW SIGNS OF DEVELOPMENT. WITH TEMPERATURES GENERALLY IN THE MID 70S TO LOWER 80S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S...MLCAPE HAS INCREASED TO 1000-1250 J/KG. MID-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT STRONG...BUT NWLY WINDS OF 30-35 KT AROUND 500 MB MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT MULTICELL STORM STRUCTURES...WITH AN ASSOCIATED THREAT OF ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS. WHILE NOT IMMEDIATELY LIKELY...A WW MAY BE NEEDED FOR PARTS OF THE MCD AREA IN THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS DEPENDING ON CONVECTIVE TRENDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL REMAINS LIKELY WITH TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS WW THIS AFTERNOON. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SLOW-MOVING CLUSTER OF SEVERE TSTMS IS PROGRESSING ACROSS THE STL METRO AREA INTO WRN IL. VERY LARGE HAIL HAS BEEN NOTED WITH THIS ACTIVITY AND LATEST MRMS DATA SUGGESTS SEVERE HAIL CONTINUES WITH UPDRAFTS OVER MONROE/ST. CLAIR COUNTY IL. 18Z SOUNDING FROM ILX EXHIBITS SUBSTANTIAL INSTABILITY WITH STRONG SFC-6KM BULK SHEAR...ALONG WITH BACKED LOW-LEVEL WINDS NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY. THIS WOULD SEEM SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND PERHAPS EVEN AN ISOLATED TORNADO. OTHERWISE...ONGOING CLUSTER NEAR STL SHOULD CONTINUE TO MATURE AS IT PROPAGATES ALONG SFC BOUNDARY ACROSS SCNTRL IL. ..DARROW.. 05/11/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL PROBABLY INITIATE ACROSS THE MCD AREA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. THE MAIN THREATS WITH THESE STORMS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS MUCH OF N-CNTRL TX...AIRMASS RECOVERY IS WELL UNDERWAY ACROSS THE MCD AREA...WITH PLENTIFUL DIURNAL HEATING ALLOWING MLCAPE VALUES TO INCREASE INTO THE 2000-3500 J/KG RANGE PER 19Z RAP MESOANALYSIS. LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CU DEVELOPING ALONG A DRYLINE EXTENDING ABOUT 40 SE LUB TO 30 E MRF...AND ALONG A BOUNDARY EXTENDING EWD FROM THE DRYLINE ACROSS MUCH OF WRN N TX. RECENT HRRR-PARALLEL RUNS SUGGEST CONVECTIVE INITIATION SHOULD OCCUR IN THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY PRESENT ACROSS THE MCD AREA COMBINED WITH A VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT AND SUFFICIENT BULK SHEAR...ANY THUNDERSTORMS THAT DO FORM WILL LIKELY POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS AS THEY DEVELOP EWD ACROSS PARTS OF N/CNTRL TX THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL AND SRN MO OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY-MORNING MCS THAT SPREAD ACROSS NRN MO HAS MOSTLY DISSIPATED...THOUGH A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER EVOLVED ALONG LEADING EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY AND NOW RESIDES OVER WCNTRL IL. OUTFLOW FROM THIS SEVERE CLUSTER IS SPREADING WEST ACROSS ECNTRL MO AND APPEARS TO BE ENHANCING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE...PER THICKENING CU FIELD. LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS BOUNDARY-LAYER CU FIELD IS BECOMING AGITATED ACROSS CNTRL/SRN MO AND THERE IS INCREASING CONCERN THAT DEEP CONVECTION MAY ULTIMATELY DEVELOP ACROSS THIS REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL THREAT FOR STRONG/GUSTY WINDS WILL EXIST THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE FOUR CORNERS REGION CONTINUES TO MOVE EWD...LARGE-SCALE ASCENT HAS INCREASED OVER THE CNTRL/SRN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD CONTINUE ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. A COLD FRONT HAS MOVED ACROSS THE MCD AREA...AND THE POST-FRONTAL AIRMASS HAS VERY LIMITED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. NONETHELESS...STRONG DIURNAL HEATING HAS ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE MID 60S TO LOWER 70S...AND MUCAPE RANGES FROM 100-300 J/KG PER 20Z RAP MESOANALYSIS. GIVEN A WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND 40-50 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW...THUNDERSTORMS MOVING ACROSS THIS REGION MAY HAVE STRONG/GUSTY DOWNDRAFT WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL INCREASE ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN INDIANA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE. WW WILL BE REQUIRED BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MATURING CLUSTER OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER SCNTRL IL IS GRADUALLY DEVELOPING AN EXPANDING PRECIP SHIELD AND COLD POOL. THIS EVOLUTION SHOULD RESULT IN AN EWD SURGE TO CONVECTION OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO AS FORWARD PROPAGATION INCREASES. ANOTHER SEVERE STORM OVER ECNTRL IL WILL SOON MOVE EAST OF WW 167. FOR THESE REASONS A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND LARGE HAIL MAY DEVELOP SEWD INTO PARTS OF WRN AND CNTRL KY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY ACROSS THE AREA BY EARLY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EXTENDING NEWD ALONG THE MS RIVER INTO THE LOWER OH VALLEY. A POCKET OF HIGHER MOISTURE CONTENT IS LOCATED ACROSS FAR SERN IL INTO SW IND AND SWD ACROSS WRN KY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER 70S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE ACROSS WRN AND CNTRL KY. THUNDERSTORMS ARE LOCATED ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY. THIS ACTIVITY IS BEING SUPPORTED BY LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. THIS CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS SW IND BUT MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP SWD INTO THE STRONGER INSTABILITY OVER WRN AND CNTRL KY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE WSR-88D VWP AT PADUCAH HAS VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT IN THE LOW LEVELS ALONG WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 35 KT. THIS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR MULTICELL ORGANIZATION ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL OR TWO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS THAT HAVE ACCESS TO THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY...ON THE SERN EDGE OF THE MCS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR HAIL RISK WILL EXIST THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TX PANHANDLE. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WILL LIKELY TRACK ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE THIS EVENING...AS WATER VAPOR LOOPS IMPLY DCVA EMERGING ACROSS PARTS OF THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS IN ADVANCE OF A MID-LEVEL TROUGH. CONVECTION IS DEEPENING AS IT SPREADS ACROSS NERN NM INTO THE NWRN TX PANHANDLE. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD/ESEWD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS ON THE SRN RIM OF SFC RIDGING IN A REGIME OF RECYCLED BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE. WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 40S TO AROUND 50F...MODIFICATIONS TO RAP SOUNDINGS INDICATE 250-1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WITHIN A NARROW W-E CORRIDOR ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE. MODERATE DEEP SHEAR AHEAD OF THE MID-LEVEL WAVE ASSOCIATED WITH LONG HODOGRAPHS FEATURING SOME CURVATURE WILL SUPPORT ISOLATED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH LARGE HAIL. THE OVERALL NARROW WIDTH OF THE BUOYANCY CORRIDOR...AND THE LIMITED MOISTURE...ARE CURRENTLY FORECAST TO LIMIT SVR COVERAGE. REGARDLESS...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 170.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF INTENSE TSTMS CONTINUE EVOLVING ACROSS THE WRN HALF OF WW 170...WITH ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING FARTHER E INTO N-CNTRL TX. ALL OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE SPREADING GENERALLY EWD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS...AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT OVERSPREADS THE REGION AHEAD OF A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS ASCENT WILL ALSO ENCOURAGE CONVECTIVE REDEVELOPMENT FROM ERN PARTS OF THE TX S PLAINS TO THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS INTO THE EVENING...ROOTED ATOP CONVECTIVELY GENERATED COLD POOLS. THE PRESENCE OF 35-45 KT OF DEEP SHEAR AND STRONG INSTABILITY IN THE INFLOW ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND POTENTIAL CONTINUING WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED ACTIVITY. ..COHEN.. 05/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASE IN THE SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL THIS EVENING...ESPECIALLY AROUND 02-04Z. LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH THIS ACTIVITY...WHICH IS FORECAST TO SPREAD GENERALLY EWD INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BECOME REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC OBS SUGGEST A FRONT LIES INVOF THE INTERSTATE 44 CORRIDOR ACROSS PARTS OF OK AND EXTENDS NEWD INTO CNTRL MO. OUN AND FWD 00Z RAOBS SAMPLE A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS E OF THIS BOUNDARY...AIDED BY UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S DEWPOINTS BENEATH AN EML. BUOYANCY IS SOMEWHAT WEAKER FARTHER NE INTO MO. WATER VAPOR LOOPS IMPLY DEEP ASCENT APPROACHING THE AFOREMENTIONED SFC BOUNDARY...AND TSTMS WILL LIKELY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY AROUND 02Z-04Z WHEN STRONGER ASCENT OVERTAKES THE BOUNDARY. FURTHERMORE...FINAL VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES OF THE DAY INDICATE BOUNDARY-LAYER CU DEEPENING E OF THE FRONT FROM ERN OK INTO NWRN AR...AND DEEPER CONVECTION COULD ARISE IN THIS CORRIDOR. ALSO...EVOLVING CONVECTION IN N TX ADDRESSED IN MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 610 COULD SPREAD NEWD WITH TIME...AS COLD POOLS EXPAND FROM ONGOING CONVECTION. MODESTLY LONG...STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS THROUGH THE CLOUD LAYER WILL SUPPORT SPLITTING STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY CONCERN. LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS COULD ALSO OCCUR...PARTICULARLY WHERE LOCALIZED COLD-POOL AMALGAMATION ENSUES. THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING THE TIMING OF MORE ROBUST INCREASE IN SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL...THOUGH THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED THROUGH THE EVENING FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL CONTINUE TO THE EAST OF WW 171 FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS. WW 171 COULD BE EXPANDED A ROW OF CONTINUES TO THE EAST OF THE WATCH TO ACCOUNT FOR THE CONTINUED THREAT. HOWEVER...THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN MARGINAL AND NEW WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW A BOWING LINE SEGMENT EXTENDING FROM SE IND SWD ACROSS ERN PARTS OF THE LOUISVILLE METRO AREA AND SWWD TO JUST TO THE NORTH OF BOWLING GREEN KY. THE LINE IS MOVING INTO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S F. THIS ALONG WITH A SEWD STORM MOTION AT 35 KTS WILL BE ENOUGH TO PRODUCE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE GUST FRONT. HOWEVER...FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS CNTRL KY EARLY THIS EVENING SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR OF GENERALLY LESS THAN 20 KT. THIS SUGGESTS THAT ANY SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN MARGINAL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 170.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM CLUSTERS FROM MINERAL WELLS TO COLEMAN TX CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/SWD WITH CONVECTIVE BACKBUILDING TAKING PLACE UPSTREAM ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS. MODEST INCREASES IN MLCINH E OF THE AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION MAY MARGINALIZE THE SVR RISK ACROSS PARTS OF N-CNTRL TX...THOUGH AMPLE BUOYANCY SAMPLED BY THE 00Z FWD RAOB SUGGESTS SVR HAIL/WIND MAY PERSIST WITH THIS ACTIVITY TOWARD W SIDES OF THE DFW METROPLEX AND VICINITY. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF A MID-LEVEL TROUGH WILL SUPPORT CONVECTIVE BACKBUILDING INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS ACROSS PARTS OF NW TX. WW 170 IS PRESENTLY SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z. HOWEVER...SOME SVR RISK MAY CONTINUE LATER INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS AS MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE INFLOW EXISTS AMIDST MODERATE DEEP SHEAR...POTENTIALLY WARRANTING EXTENSION OF THE WW IN TIME OR A NEW WW. ..COHEN.. 05/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS SPREADING ACROSS THE REGION MAY PRODUCE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS...AND THIS MAY WARRANT ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING SUPERCELL TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/SEWD WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF MODEST BUOYANCY. THE PRESENCE OF 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH...AND STRONG HIGH-LEVEL FLOW SUPPORTING LONG HODOGRAPHS...WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN A SVR HAIL RISK INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. AS THIS ACTIVITY ENCOUNTERS SOMEWHAT RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE INTO PARTS OF SWRN OK AND VICINITY...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT INTENSIFICATION OF THE AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION MAY OCCUR... ESPECIALLY GIVEN MODERATELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SAMPLED BY THE 00Z AMA RAOB. HOWEVER...GROWING NOCTURNAL MLCINH AND ONLY MODEST BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE MAY RESULT IN LIMITED SVR COVERAGE OVERALL...RESULTING IN SOME UNCERTAINTY IN THE NECESSITY OF A NEW WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS SE MO...SRN IL INTO FAR WRN KY FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS. THE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE BEYOND THE WATCH EXPIRATION AND A LOCAL EXTENSION MAY BE NEEDED. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW A BOWING LINE SEGMENT OVER FAR SRN IL THAT HAS BEEN SUSTAINED IN INTENSITY OVER THE LAST FEW HOURS. THIS BOWING LINE IS LOCATED ALONG A TIGHT GRADIENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY NEAR AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LEFT OVER FROM PREVIOUS CONVECTION. AS THE LINE CONTINUES TO MOVE ESEWD...A MAX IN LOW-LEVEL FLOW WHICH IS ANALYZED BY THE RAP NEAR THE IL-KY STATELINE...WILL HELP TO SUSTAIN STRONG UPDRAFTS WITHIN THE BOWING LINE SEGMENT. MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS ALONG WITH AN ESEWD MOVEMENT AT 35 KT WILL MAKE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS A POSSIBILITY WITH THE STRONGER PARTS OF THE LINE. THIS THREAT SHOULD PERSIST AND A LOCAL EXTENSION MAY BE NEEDED FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE MOVING INTO ERN OK AND NW AR OVER THE NEXT 2 TO 3 HOURS. LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS BUT A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS CAN NOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM SW MO INTO ERN AND SRN OK. THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE BOUNDARY OVER THE LAST COUPLE OF HOURS IN RESPONSE TO INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AN APPROACHING UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH MOVING INTO THE SRN PLAINS. MODERATE INSTABILITY...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND SUBSTANTIAL EFFECTIVE SHEAR SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR ROTATING STORMS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. ALTHOUGH A NEAR SFC INVERSION EXISTS IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER....A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS CAN NOT BE RULED OUT WITH THE STRONGER DOWNDRAFTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS NOW APPROACHING OR SPREADING ACROSS THE WICHITA FALLS TX/LAWTON OK FINALLY APPEAR TO BE IN THE PROCESS OF WEAKENING WITH DIMINISHING SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PAIR OF LONG-LIVED STORMS WITH SUPERCELL STRUCTURES APPEAR TO BE OUTRUNNING SUPPORTING FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION...WHICH GENERALLY REMAINS FOCUSED ACROSS THE TEXAS PANHANDLE. ALTHOUGH A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES APPEARS TO EXTEND EAST SOUTHEASTWARD ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE RED RIVER THROUGH MUCH OF NORTHERN TEXAS...STORMS ARE DEVELOPING INTO AN AREA OF VEERED/WESTERLY 700 MB FLOW. LESS FAVORABLE SHEAR WITHIN THIS REGIME...COUPLED WITH INGESTION OF DRIER AIR WITHIN THE INFLOW /AS INDICATED BY LATEST RAPID REFRESH OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS/...SUGGESTS RAPID WEAKENING TRENDS OF STORMS EVIDENT IN LATEST MRMS DATA WILL CONTINUE. ..KERR.. 05/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY CONTINUE ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS WHILE SPREADING EAST OF WATCH 172. HOWEVER...WITH LITTLE POTENTIAL FOR APPRECIABLE FURTHER INTENSIFICATION...ANOTHER WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FORCING FOR ASCENT ALONG A SOUTHEASTWARD ADVANCING FRONTAL ZONE CONTINUES TO SUPPORT AN EVOLVING LINE OF STORMS ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHEASTERN OKLAHOMA INTO PARTS OF NORTHWESTERN ARKANSAS. VERTICAL SHEAR ACROSS THIS REGION IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG. HOWEVER...SOUTHEASTERLY/SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL SYSTEM-RELATIVE WINDS ARE SUPPORTING INFLOW OF AIR STILL CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATELY LARGE CAPE. THIS MAY MAINTAIN VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ANOTHER FEW HOURS...WITH 20-30 KT WESTERLY DEEP-LAYER MEAN FLOW CONTRIBUTING TO A GRADUAL EASTWARD PROGRESSION INTO AND THROUGH PORTIONS OF THE OZARK PLATEAU. ..KERR.. 05/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONGER STORMS MAY MAINTAIN A RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG SURFACE GUSTS ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MODEST /30-40 KT AT 850 MB/ SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET EXTENDING ACROSS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU TOWARD THE SOUTH PLAINS IS SUPPORTING RENEWED VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PARTS OF THE TEXAS SOUTH PLAINS AND BIG COUNTRY. THIS IS GENERALLY OCCURRING ABOVE A RESIDUAL CONGLOMERATE SURFACE COLD POOL GENERATED BY EARLIER CONVECTION...BUT NEWER STORMS NORTHWEST/WEST NORTHWEST OF ABILENE ARE OCCURRING ALONG/ABOVE A SOUTHWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT. 25 KT WESTERLY DEEP-LAYER MEAN FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A CONTINUING GENERAL EAST SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATION OF PRE-FRONTAL STORMS. DESPITE THE ELEVATED NATURE OF EVEN THIS ACTIVITY...THE INFLOW OF MOIST AIR CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATELY LARGE CAPE MAY CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STORMS OCCASIONALLY CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SEVERE HAIL...AND PERHAPS LOCALIZED POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS. THIS THREAT MAY BEGIN TO DIMINISH BY 10-11Z...AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET WEAKENS AND/OR IS OVERTAKEN BY THE COLD FRONT. ..KERR.. 05/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
